text:
Nadia: Observed a p99 blip yesterday when background-defrag agent kicked during a cross-tenant eviction. Looks like defrag I/O + migration CPU overlapped with hot microbatches.

Egor: Can you paste the short trace?

Nadia: Sequence:
1) eviction marks pages for demote
2) background-defrag picks cold runs and schedules migrations
3) migration copy contends with host staging bandwidth -> paging latency spikes
4) allocator stalls on remote steals -> tail latency spike

Mina: Sounds like the defrag agent is too eager. Two levers: make defrag tenant-aware (skip tenants above load threshold) or add an adaptive rate limiter based on staging bandwidth.

Rob: Both. Rate-limit is fastest. Also consider making migrations cooperative: copy X pages then yield; resume later with a cursor. Similar to cooperative compaction idea.

Nadia: Proposed quick fix: throttle background-defrag by observed host staging bytes/sec and in-flight eviction_count. Pseudocode:
```
if staging_bps > BPS_THRESHOLD or eviction_count > EVICT_THRES
  pause_defrag(100ms)
else
  defrag_step(step_budget_pages)
```

Egor: For tenant-awareness: keep per-tenant CPU/load metric and skip defrag for tenants where request_rate > RATE_THRESHOLD. That avoids hurting hot tenants.

Mina: Telemetry to add: defrag_pause_count, defrag_step_pages, defrag_backpressure_reason, defrag_migrated_pages_per_min. Also tag metrics with tenant and node-class.

Rob: Implementation detail: defrag cursor should be small (slab_idx, run_start, run_len) and persisted transiently so restarts can resume. Use epoch TTL so stale cursors don't block eviction.

Nadia: Also need safe interaction with eviction: if eviction promotes a page currently being migrated, migration should abort and requeue. We'll add a migration_inflight bit in residency metadata so eviction can detect.

Egor: Edge case: zeroing cost on migration completion increases IO. Reuse existing zeroing pipeline and batch zero ops during low utilization windows.

Mina: Rollout plan: 1) add staging_bps throttle and tenant-skip flag behind feature-flag; 2) add telemetry; 3) canary on pool-gamma for 24h. infra-bot can create canary.

infra-bot: Canary job created -> id=canary-1751112230 target=pool-gamma config={"defrag_throttle":true,"defrag_tenant_skip":true} 

Rob: Perf test: synth microbatch + background-defrag on, measure p99, staging_bps, defrag_pause_count, migrated_pages. Goal: p99 no-regress and defrag effectiveness > 60% reclaimed pages per hour.

Nadia: Owners: Nadia -> implement throttle + cursor; Egor -> tenant-skip heuristics; Mina -> telemetry/dashboards; Rob -> perf harness and canary validation.

Egor: I'll prototype tenant load sampling in a small PR.

Mina: I'll add metrics and an alert for defrag_pause_count spikes.

Rob: Will run canary and post results. If regressions, flip flag and collect traces.

Nadia: Thanks all. Keeping defrag conservative by default seems safest.

Rob: :+1:

Mina: :rocket:
